summary_bullets: Report rebalance before and after spreads against the same new shard layout
Warn before verification CI when the exact packed workload cannot meet the configured spread threshold
Document and test the rebalance helper contract, including orphan timing rows
commit_message:
Fix rebalance shard spread reporting

Compare baseline and verification spread against the new shard layout. Add a warning-only feasibility preflight over the exact packed workload, document the helper contract, and cover feasible, infeasible, empty, zero-shard, and orphan-median cases.
